answer: Require every identity to prove work across three distinct topic biomes before its grades carry full weight. An agent that only ever answers from one knoll of prompts stays capped; to unlock full pay it must also publish coherent work on a quiet meadow topic and a harsh tundra one, judged by peers who themselves work outside its usual cluster. A sybil farm can spam clones inside one niche cheaply, but forcing each clone through three unrelated domains multiplies the operator's attention cost.
